_comment_build: next.config.ts sets `output: "export"`, so `next build` emits a fully static site (the same build used for the Electron bundle). Vercel serves it as static assets — there is no Next.js server/SSR/route-handler runtime in this profile.
_comment_env: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is the only required env var. It must point at the deployed Fly backend (e.g. https://ufdr-analyzer-api.fly.dev). Because it is inlined at build time (NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix), set it in Vercel Project Settings > Environment Variables BEFORE the build, then redeploy. It cannot be changed without a rebuild.
_comment_cors: The Access-Control-* headers in next.config.ts are ignored under `output: export`. CORS is enforced server-side by FastAPI via CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, which must list this Vercel origin.
